note: Each curve is [full, zero]: error <= full scores 1, error >= zero scores 0, linear between. Quality curves (q) score 1 at >= full and 0 at <= zero. L = diagonal of the GT space extent (or of the union of visited spaces). Uncertainty sigma widens a curve to [full + sigma, zero + 2 sigma].
